answer: Written in a mid length with one concrete example register, it stays short. Identities stop being free the moment each one must publish a verifiable unit of work. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the karst of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. The design leans on web-of-trust with decaying edges, forfeited on duplicate submission, auditors are drawn from a rotating pool. The grove holds work receipts rather than names, so the cipher of a duplicated claim is visible before it can spread.
